summary: Empirical Playwright verification (desktop 1280x900) of the DOUBLED Edit Canvas View expansion in NoteModal. Opened Uncategorized → T2 → accordion-edit → modal 'Edit Note'. Toggled data-testid='note-canvas-view-toggle'. All sizing/behavior assertions PASS.

click_expands_canvas_doubled.note: max-w-lg(512)→max-w-5xl(1024) ✓; max-h [85vh]→[95vh] ✓; textarea minRows 3→25, maxRows 20→44 (doubled from prior 14/32); contenteditable min-h min(38rem,65vh) max-h [85vh] (prev min-h 22rem max-h 65vh).

icon_swaps_maximize_to_minimize.note: SVG inner HTML contains 'minimize' when expanded.

reset_on_reopen.note: NoteModal.jsx L411 `if (!isOpen) return null` unmounts the component; canvasExpanded is a local useState(false). Live reopen was flaky only because the accordion row collapsed between opens (unrelated to the toggle).

action_items: No action required. Doubled canvas sizing confirmed: dialog width 512→1024 (2.00x), editor textarea height 78→518px (minRows 3→25 as configured at NoteModal.jsx L563-564), contenteditable min-h min(38rem,65vh) and max-h [85vh] applied (L545). All aria/data attributes toggle correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: NoteModal.jsx L545: contenteditable uses `min-h-[min(38rem,65vh)] max-h-[85vh]` when expanded — clamp via `min()` prevents overflow on short viewports; good.
L563-564: textarea minRows/maxRows pair (25/44) matches the new 85vh dialog max-height and doubled canvas intent.
L417: `max-w-5xl max-h-[95vh]` on DialogContent — on 1280x900 viewport dialog measured 1024x855 (95vh=855). Content inside is overflow-y-auto so taller editors scroll internally.
L411 unmount-on-close guarantees reset-on-reopen without needing a useEffect to reset canvasExpanded.
No regression on header icon cluster (Templates / Help / Toggle / Brightness) nor on floating RTE toolbar interact-outside guard (L420-429).

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 empirical scenarios PASS; reset-on-reopen verified by code inspection.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro: 1280x900 → expand Uncategorized → click 'T2' tile → click data-testid='accordion-edit-{id}' → modal opens → click data-testid='note-canvas-view-toggle'. Dialog 512→1024, textarea height ~78→518px, aria/data-state/aria-label flip; icon flips Maximize2↔Minimize2. Re-reopen requires re-expanding the accordion.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — sizing-only follow-up to iteration_122; verified.
